checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals promo-sequence, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals promo-sequence.

checks.description: The flow is an ordered escalating-urgency ladder and each message has step, trigger, segment, channel, and a copy variant ref.
checks.rule: Output flow lists ordered messages, each with id, step, trigger, segment, channel, copy_ref, and subject_ref; the cadence tightens toward the deadline.

checks.description: Each message references a QA-passed copy variant by id; the flow never writes copy.
checks.rule: Body states each message binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id and that the flow sequences copy and does not write it.

checks.description: The window, offer, discount, dates, occasion, Skill Path title, and instructor lineup trace exactly to the brief and context; nothing invented and no manufactured extension.
checks.rule: Body states the window, offer, discount, dates, occasion, Skill Path title, and lineup trace to the brief and forbids invented values and a manufactured urgency or extension.

checks.description: Each email is a multi-instructor email per context/multi-instructor-angles.md: one reader outcome as the umbrella, one primary CTA, per-card links as quiet secondaries.
checks.rule: Body references context/multi-instructor-angles.md, states each email unifies the lineup under one reader outcome, and keeps one primary CTA with per-card links as quiet secondaries.

checks.description: Every named instructor is catalog-status-confirmed and every credential page-cleared, or the card is dropped.
checks.rule: Body states every named instructor must be catalog-status-confirmed and every credential page-cleared, else the card is dropped.

checks.description: Audience size is resolved from live data at send time.
checks.rule: Body and output state audience_size is resolved at send from live owned-audience data.

checks.description: A one plain sentence send_on_approval describes what the send does and to how many.
checks.rule: Output includes a send_on_approval one-sentence statement of what the send does and to how many.

checks.description: Suppression excludes paying contacts for the promoted product, unsubscribes, hard bounces, and already-converted contacts.
checks.rule: Output suppression names paying contacts, unsubscribed, hard-bounced, and already-converted, and the flow excludes them.

checks.description: The platform open item is surfaced; the package is not-sendable until confirmed and approved.
checks.rule: Body marks the platform open item and marks the package design-only and not-sendable until the platform is confirmed and approved.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals, empowering not deficit-framed, no accreditation implication, RTL-safe Arabic.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals; any Arabic example is empowering and RTL-safe; no accreditation implication.
